category_edits.rationale: Use dilation schedule [1,2,4,1,2,4] across all four category models to emphasize nearby interactions in short histories while retaining both causal convolutions per block. The generated predictor imports this same model class, keeping training and inference consistent without changing checkpoint shapes, features, embeddings, readout, loss, or optimizer.

change_summary: Change NextItNet’s six-block dilation schedule to [1,2,4,1,2,4] for all four datasets; prediction uses the updated architecture through its existing model-class import.
